theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcdr_order_stat
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ u : Fin P → ℝ, ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, κ u ≤ u i) ∧ (∀ u : Fin P → ℝ, ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, u i ≤ κ u) ∧ ∀ u v : Fin P → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, (∀ i, |u i - v i| ≤ t) → |κ u - κ v| ≤ t
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
